name: job-watch
description: Live pane of long-running jobs (training, downloads, extractions): progress, ETA, stalls and finishes, read from their logs with no model calls; jobs_list / jobs_watch / jobs_unwatch tools so Claude follows jobs instead of polling them.

stallMinutes.title: Stall after (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A job whose log has not grown for this long is flagged as stalled (if its process is alive) or quiet.

stallReminderMinutes.title: Stall reminder every (minutes)
stallReminderMinutes.description: After a job's first stall toast, the least time before it is toasted about again: a reminder while it stays silent ("still silent after 2h10m"), or its stall once more after it wrote a line and went quiet again. 0 toasts each job's first stall only.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often logs, processes and disks are re-read.

keepDoneMinutes.title: Keep finished jobs (minutes)
keepDoneMinutes.description: How long a finished job stays in the pane before it is dropped. A timer (a bare sleep of Claude's) leaves after a minute.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a job starts
autoOpen.description: Open the Jobs pane automatically the first time a long job is picked up.

disks.title: Disks to show
disks.description: Comma-separated mount points to show free space for. Empty shows / and everything under /Volumes.
